**SECTION D: COMPOSITION (10 MARKS)**

*Write an essay of between 200 and 250 words on **one** of the following topics:*

questions.enonce_markdown: **1.** You are the President of the Student's union in your school. You want to deliver a speech on the occasion of the Youth Day on 11th of February, on violence in the school milieu. Write a speech in which you explain the causes, say who the perpetrators and the victims are and what should be done to solve the problem. Your name is Makouot and you study in GHS Nkoupit.
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un discours (speech) obéit à une structure imposée : une formule d'adresse à l'auditoire, une introduction qui annonce le sujet, un développement organisé (ici : causes, acteurs, solutions comme demandé par la consigne), et une formule de clôture qui remercie ou interpelle l'auditoire. Le format compte autant que le contenu : un correcteur pénalise une composition qui ressemble à un essai plutôt qu'à un discours réellement prononcé à voix haute.

### Corrigé détaillé étape par étape
Modèle de discours respectant la consigne (environ 220 mots) :

« Fellow students, teachers, and members of the administration of GHS Nkoupit, good morning.

My name is Makouot, President of the Student's Union, and I am honoured to address you on this Youth Day, the 11th of February, on a problem that concerns all of us: violence in our school milieu.

Violence in schools has many causes. Peer pressure pushes some students to prove themselves through fighting. Frustration linked to poor academic results, family problems at home, and the influence of violent content on social media also push students towards aggressive behaviour. Sadly, both the perpetrators and the victims are often students themselves, though in some cases teachers and non-teaching staff can also be involved, either as aggressors or as targets of disrespect.

To solve this problem, I propose three concrete actions. First, the school should organise regular sensitisation talks on non-violent conflict resolution. Second, a listening unit run by trained counsellors should be created so that troubled students can express themselves before turning to violence. Third, strict but fair sanctions must be applied consistently, so that violence is never seen as acceptable or without consequence.

Dear fellow students, building a peaceful school is our shared responsibility. Let us choose dialogue over aggression, and turn GHS Nkoupit into a model of discipline and mutual respect.

Thank you for your attention. »

### Piège à éviter
Rédiger un texte qui ressemble à une dissertation classique (avec « Introduction, I, II, III, Conclusion ») sans jamais s'adresser directement à l'auditoire fait perdre des points de forme, même si le contenu sur les causes et les solutions est correct.

### Conseil
Commence toujours un discours par une formule d'adresse (« Fellow students... », « Dear friends... ») et termine-le par une formule de clôture (« Thank you », « I thank you for your attention ») : ce sont les deux marqueurs de forme les plus faciles à vérifier pour le correcteur, et les plus faciles à oublier sous la pression de l'examen.

Le format compte autant que le contenu : un correcteur pénalise une composition qui ressemble à un essai plutôt qu'à un discours réellement prononcé à voix haute.

questions.enonce_markdown: **2.** Write an article to be published in *Cameroon Tribune* Newspaper: « War is not the best solution to resolve social conflicts in the world. » Your article should sensitise perpetrators of war on the dangerous consequences on individuals, properties and the state in general.
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un article de presse (newspaper article) s'ouvre par un titre accrocheur puis, souvent, la mention du journal, avant un développement informatif et persuasif structuré en paragraphes courts, chacun centré sur une idée. Contrairement à l'essai scolaire classique, l'article de presse recherche l'impact immédiat sur le lecteur, avec un ton plus direct.

### Corrigé détaillé étape par étape
Modèle d'article respectant la consigne (environ 220 mots) :

« WAR: NEVER THE RIGHT ANSWER TO OUR CONFLICTS

*Cameroon Tribune*

Across the world, from local disputes to international crises, war is too often presented as an inevitable solution to conflict. Yet a closer look at its consequences shows that war destroys far more than it ever solves.

On individuals, the cost is the heaviest. Soldiers and civilians alike lose their lives, families are torn apart, and survivors carry lifelong physical and psychological wounds. Children who grow up in war zones are deprived of education and a normal childhood, which compromises their entire future.

On properties, war leaves behind ruins instead of solutions. Schools, hospitals, roads and homes, built over decades, can be destroyed within days of fighting, forcing nations to rebuild from nothing at an enormous financial cost.

On the state in general, war weakens institutions, drains national budgets that could fund healthcare or education, and often leaves deep divisions between communities that take generations to heal, long after the guns fall silent.

Dialogue, negotiation and international mediation remain far more effective tools to resolve social conflicts, because they preserve human life and build lasting solutions instead of temporary victories built on destruction.

It is time for all perpetrators of war to understand that true strength lies in the courage to negotiate, not in the willingness to destroy. »

### Piège à éviter
Oublier le titre en majuscules ou en gras en tête de l'article : c'est l'élément visuel qui signale immédiatement au correcteur qu'il s'agit bien d'un article de presse et non d'un essai.

### Conseil
Structure ton article en paragraphes courts, chacun consacré à UNE seule conséquence (individus, biens, État comme demandé ici) : cette organisation claire est ce que recherchent les correcteurs dans un article de sensibilisation.

questions.enonce_markdown: **3.** The Commonwealth has organised a writing competition for the best essays in Cameroon. The topic is as follows: « A social problem that is important to you, such as poverty, access to healthcare, or access to education or use of social media. » Write your essay in which you identify the problem, say why it is important to you. Explain using your personal experiences how this problem has affected you and others in your community. Propose possible solutions that can solve this problem.
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un essai argumentatif (composition) suit une structure classique en trois temps : une introduction qui présente le problème choisi et annonce le plan, un développement qui explique l'importance du problème, l'illustre par une expérience personnelle et propose des solutions, et une conclusion qui résume l'essentiel et ouvre sur une perspective d'avenir.

### Corrigé détaillé étape par étape
Modèle d'essai respectant la consigne, sur le thème de l'accès à l'éducation (environ 230 mots) :

« Among the many social problems affecting Cameroon today, access to education is the one that matters most to me, because I have seen first-hand how the lack of it can change the course of a young person's life.

This problem is important to me because education is the foundation on which every other opportunity is built. Without it, young people struggle to find decent jobs, understand their rights, or contribute fully to their community's development.

In my own neighbourhood, I have a cousin who had to drop out of secondary school because our family could not afford the school fees after our father lost his job. Today, at nineteen, he works as a motorbike rider, a job that barely allows him to survive, while his former classmates who continued their studies now have far better prospects. I have seen how this single interruption in his education limited every choice available to him afterwards, and I have watched similar situations affect several other young people in my community.

To solve this problem, the government should extend free basic education programmes to cover secondary school fees for children from low-income families. Communities could also organise scholarship funds supported by local businesses, and schools could offer flexible payment plans instead of demanding fees in one instalment.

Education is not a luxury; it is the key that opens every other door. If we want a stronger, fairer Cameroon, guaranteeing access to education for every child must become a true national priority. »

### Piège à éviter
Choisir un exemple personnel trop vague (« many people around me suffer from this problem ») sans détail concret fait perdre des points sur la partie « personal experience » explicitement demandée par la consigne.

### Conseil
Choisis un exemple personnel précis (une personne, une situation datée, un lieu) plutôt qu'une généralité : c'est ce niveau de détail concret que les correcteurs valorisent le plus dans la partie expérience personnelle.

incertitudes: Section D : le candidat ne traite qu'UN SEUL des trois sujets proposés le jour de l'examen ; les trois modèles de corrigé (discours, article, essai) sont fournis intégralement pour couvrir chaque choix possible, conformément à la consigne 'candidat traite un sujet au choix' du référentiel.
